title: Chapter 1199
text:
The change in the Limitless Financial Group faction was just an interlude in the entire national war. After a portion of the players changed sides on the spot, the heat quickly subsided, and the various guild alliances continued to focus on fighting each other.

The war progressed day by day, and a large number of players were eliminated every day. Because the number of revivals decreased, the surviving guild alliances became more and more cautious, not daring to act recklessly anymore. Coupled with the fact that many guilds had already been eliminated, the overall situation was not as intense as it had been in the first two days.

Because the Golden Alliance had always been at the top of the leaderboard, their advantage was too great. On the fifth day, the Black Star Corps faction was jointly attacked by the Anti- Black Star Battlefront, the three Universal Civilizations Battlefront, and a bunch of scattered guild alliances, resulting in the most tragic battle since the start of the war.

Although the Golden Alliance had an advantage in terms of average strength and revivals, they were at a disadvantage in terms of numbers, after all, so they could not continue to maintain the excellent battle loss ratio. Their average death count jumped from 5.89 to 7.38.

However, the advantage that the Golden Alliance had accumulated over the past few days was too strong. Even though their losses in this battle were not small, they still did not drop from the top of the leaderboard. Before this battle, only the Golden Alliance's death count did not exceed 6. The base number of the other guild alliances was too high. For example, the second place on the leaderboard was the September Council of the three Universal Civilizations Battlefront. After the bloody battle, their average death count rose from 6.71 to 7.68. Although they won the battle, their total value was still not as high as the Golden Alliance's.

According to the analysis on the forums, the threshold of the average death count was 9. Exceeding this number meant that the troops had lost their combat power. Now, the various guild alliances were infinitely close to this number.

On the sixth day, the forces that had not been eliminated did not want to start a war. They all seemed to be planning to survive this day to refresh their revival count. Planet Milton suddenly became much quieter, with only sporadic flames of war.

However, at night, the planet suddenly became lively again. The various guild alliances began to fight crazily. They took action at this time to buy time.

This was because a player who used up all his revivals in six days would be considered permanently eliminated. Even if he refreshed on the sixth day, he would not be qualified to participate in the war again. The guild alliances planned to use the troops with healthier revivals to eliminate the 'heavily injured' with an average death count of 9.0 on the sixth night, weakening the opponent's troops. This way, after the refresh in the morning, it would be equivalent to zero losses.

On the sixth night, it directly turned into a great battle royale. Countless players fled in all directions, only wanting to survive the night. Meanwhile, the players who were slightly healthier turned into hunters, chasing after the "heavily injured" with obscene smiles.

Of course, the roles of hunter and prey could be switched. From time to time, a hunter would become the prey and join the fleeing team. Compared to the fierce and hot-blooded battles of the past few days, the sixth night seemed to have turned into a game of hide-and-seek. Amidst the horror, there was also a bit of joy.

That night was the largest elimination wave since the start of the war. A total of 70% of the players had been sent away. On the morning of the seventh day, when the resurrection count refreshed, less than half of the Guild Alliance's forces remained. Meanwhile, the other independent powers were even worse off. Most of them only had a quarter to a fifth of their forces left.

Their plan to end the war within six days had failed. However, the size of their forces had been reduced, and the amount of resources they needed to invest had also decreased. The various large guild alliances could only lead their remaining forces and fight for another six days. They were basically out of ammunition and food.

In the third cycle, on the morning of the thirteenth day, there were only six Guild Alliances left on Planet Milton. The Golden Alliance was one of them, and relatively speaking, it was also the force that had preserved its strength the best. However, all the players who had been eliminated did not leave. They still sat in their battleships and watched the battle in the outer space of Planet Milton, placing bets on who would be the winner of the final circle.

Because the margin for error had become even lower, everyone became more cautious. Under such circumstances, it became more and more difficult to eliminate the opponent's forces. As a result, the six Guild Alliances all chose to attack and win by eliminating the opponent's stronghold.

After the first two cycles of war, the various Guild Alliances now did not have many troops left, causing the intensity of the battle to be far less than in the first cycle. At this time, another advantage of the Golden Alliance was greatly magnified, and that was the ability of the Evolution Badge!

The Aberrant Body had strength far beyond the current level of players, but its shortcomings were also obvious. That was, it could not attack from afar and could only engage in close combat. Moreover, most of its skills were frozen. As a result, in large-scale army battles, the Aberrant Body's advantage could not be fully utilized. This was because the focus fire was too fierce, and the Aberrant Body could not hold on for too long.

However, in small and medium-sized battles, the enemy's focus fire power would decrease, and the Aberrant Body's time on the field would increase, increasing the tactical effect of the Aberrant Body.

At this point, the Golden Alliance no longer deliberately pursued the advantage of battle losses. It was not a loss to use the number of resurrections to destroy strongholds. They relied on the Aberrant Body's powerful attack power to attack strongholds one after another. On the fifteenth day, two Guild Alliances had been eliminated by them.

On the seventeenth day, there were finally only two survivors left, namely the Golden Alliance and the Galactic Business Alliance. The two sides reached an agreement not to attack strongholds, but to fight head-on until there was no one left. They hoped that the first national war would end in a way that left no regrets.

The two sides decided to finish what they started, and the battlefield was chosen to be the Dragon Hill, which had now become the Dragon Canyon. The two sides fought from morning to night, and in the end, the Golden Alliance won with a narrow advantage, killing everyone in the Galactic Business Alliance. In the end, only less than two thousand core players of the Chinese guilds were left on the field.

The Nation War came to an end with such a result. As soon as it ended, the forums were filled with the celebration of the Chinese players. Even the players who were eliminated politely sent congratulatory messages, congratulating the Yan Huang Alliance for being the final winner of the first Nation War. The Galaxy Times and the reporters from all over the world also published reports. Especially the war reporters led by Bun-Hit-Dog, they were full of praises and praised the Yan Huang Alliance from the start. They started from the era of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors. It was so corny that even the Chinese players felt numb when they read it.

The Galaxy Chronicles was updated in real-time, naming the first national war as the "Battle of Milton", and all the battles, big and small, were recorded in it. Because the chronicles were compiled by all players, such a huge project was not a problem at all. As long as everyone recorded the battles they had experienced, the entire process of the national war could be completely restored.

After the national war ended, the players did not leave immediately. Many people reluctantly returned to Planet Milton to clean up the environment. They did not demolish the strongholds built by the various guilds, but instead used engineering machines to transform them into cities.

Because it was rare for people from all sides to gather together, some players set up stalls, and soon others joined in. It was as if this place had become a trading area. Many PK players were itching to fight, and they looked for people to spar with. Planet Milton became lively again, and many players seemed to treat this place as a new main city.

…

In the office of the Black Star Palace, Han Xiao closed the forum interface with a smile on his face.

"After more than half a month, it's finally over. It took much longer than in my previous life."

He did not provide any help during the whole process, and he was quite happy to see the Yan Huang Alliance win. The Chinese players achieved a good result, proving that his efforts in the past four versions were fruitful.

The first national war in his previous life had a far-reaching impact, and it was one of the symbols of the Galaxy Chronicles. The rules of the battlefield had been passed down and became a tradition recognized by the players. If there were any national wars in the future, these rules would be followed. The victory of the Yan Huang Alliance would definitely increase the attractiveness of the faction, which was equivalent to endless free advertising. In the future, when new players chose a faction, they would first consider the army, and if old players opened smurf accounts, they would most likely join the Black Star Corps, which had huge potential benefits.

Most importantly, the national war had been fought for so long, and it had brought him far more benefits than he expected!

Han Xiao opened the interface and looked at the value of the EXP bar, and he could not help but smile.

"There are still about two months before the Pro League. I thought it would take a while to get enough EXP, but I didn't expect to get enough EXP this time …"

According to his calculations, he should have accumulated enough EXP to level up from level 331 to level 340, which was earlier than expected!

A large portion of the EXP was contributed by the former Limitless Financial Group player who had changed his backer midway.

"Little Soro, Little Soro, thank you for your help. Half of the Military Medal is yours."

Han Xiaoxin was elated.

Finally, he had accumulated enough EXP. Without any hesitation, he directly put all the EXP into leveling up.

[Divine Throne Mechanic] leveled up to LV32. + 500 Energy, + 5 STR, + 5 DEX, + 18 END, + 25 INT. You have received 20 Free Attribute Points and 1 Awakening Point.

…

[Divine Throne Mechanic] leveled up to LV40. + 500 Energy, + 5 STR, + 5 DEX, + 18 END, + 25 INT. You have received 20 Free Attribute Points and 1 Awakening Point.

You have received the LV340 Promotion Mission!

LV340 Promotion Mission: One of the [God's Trait Transformation] has reached Level 10.

"Hmm?"

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

His [God's Trait Transformation-Machinery] had already reached Level 9, and he only needed to build one more Universal Treasure to reach Level 10.

The upper limit of the Divine Throne Mechanic class was level 60,340. There was no Class Advancement Mission, only the Promotion Mission. As long as he completed this requirement, he could advance.

"It doesn't seem that difficult this time …"

Han Xiao could not help but have such a thought, but he then shook his head and laughed.

It's not that the mission is not difficult, but I'm just too good.

He originally wanted to throw a Mission Completion Card, but seeing this, he gave up on the idea. Anyway, he would definitely level up his [God's Trait Transformation], so there was no need to waste a Mission Completion Card. After the Intelligent Plague incident, the dynasty had already opened up the exchange channel for Gold Grade blueprints, and he had enough Contribution Points. He could directly exchange for a blueprint and build it at home. It would not take long, and he still had the patience.

Furthermore, the effect of the Evolution Cube depended on his Energy Level. Now that he had the Dragon Emperor Star Energy Absorption Technique, Han Xiao planned to raise his Energy Level to a higher level and obtain an additional bonus from the Evolution Cube. This would not take much time because his current Energy Level was not far from the standard for the next level.

Han Xiao directly took out his communicator and contacted the people of the Red Empire. After expressing his needs in this regard, he soon received a list of blueprints that could be exchanged from the Red Empire.

He browsed through it carefully, selected one, and sent out an exchange request.

Next, he only needed to wait for the upper echelons of the dynasty to complete the approval, and he would be able to obtain the blueprint.

Gold Grade blueprints were extremely precious to Mechanics, and they could not be bought even if they had the money. However, at the height that Han Technician was at, such a rare resource could be easily obtained. Having power in his hands was truly satisfying.

Han Xiaoxin was in a good mood. Playing with the communicator while waiting for the dynasty's reply, he casually glanced at the lively scene on Planet Milton on the monitor and suddenly had an idea.

In his previous life, the location of the first national war was like Planet Milton now, one of the main cities with commemorative significance. Unfortunately, after the last version update, that planet was requisitioned and was no longer open to the public. It had always been a place that many players regretted.

"When the three Universal Civilizations and the Supercluster Alliance are done fighting, the fourth exploration phase will officially be included in the explored universe. I might as well buy Planet Milton and the surrounding few planets and give them to the Yan Huang Alliance …"

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

This move would not only deepen the army's presence among the players but also reward the Yan Huang Alliance.

The excellent results of the Yan Huang Alliance had brought him huge benefits. Although this was an internal matter among the players, he could not be too stingy. He should do something to deepen the army's sense of belonging to the faction.

Isn't it just a few planets? How much money is that? He could just buy them.
